hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
If condition flag "swallow_done" is up this frame, then
  Let v be call helper2.
  If v is not empty, then
    Choose state 21 next.
    Set the register's 'swallowedBattleBegin' to true.
    Set the register's 'swallowedForce' to false.
    Set the register's 'turnCount' to 1 and stop.
  Set the register's 'swallowedForce' to false.
  Set the register's 'isReservedSwallow' to true.
If condition flag "turn_transit" is up this frame, then increase the register's 'turnCount' by one.
If run helper is not the register's 'currBpIdx', then
  Increase the register's 'currBpIdx' by one.
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNo' on the enemy.
  The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'swallowedForce' or the register's 'swallowedBattleBegin' and the register's 'turnCount' is at least the numeric entry list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'turnsToRegurgitate' in aiArg, then the enemy uses the move labelled "swallow".
  Otherwise
    If the register's 'isReservedSwallow', then
      Set the register's 'isReservedSwallow' to false.
      Set the register's 'swallowedForce' to true.
    The enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

hooks.logic:
Let container be the group of the enemy.
If condition flag "countup_turn" is up this frame, then increase the register's 'swallowedTurn' by one.
If condition flag "weakness_damage" is up this frame, then increase the register's 'weaknessDamageCount' by one.
If run helper is not the register's 'currBpIdx', then
  Increase the register's 'currBpIdx' by one.
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNoForSwallow' on the enemy.
  The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
If the enemy can act, then
  If the register's 'weaknessDamageCount' is at least the numeric entry "count_of_weakness_damage" in the battle settings of container, then
    Choose state 22 next.
    Set the register's 'weaknessDamageCount' to 0 and stop.
  Otherwise
    If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
    Stop.

script_hooks.logic:
Let enemyContainer be the enemy group.
Let helper4 be given (arg1, arg2) { If arg2 meets the move condition {canHookOfReceivedDamageOrHeal: true} and arg2's 'receiver' has the SWALLOWED status, then { If arg2's 'damage' is at least 0, then return 0. Otherwise, return -1. } Otherwise, return arg2's 'damage'. }.
Hook (helper4 tied to this state) into enemyContainer's 'aiHook' as the ADJUST_DAMAGE hook named "adjustDamageReceive".
Let helper5 be given (arg) { If every member in the living party where member has the SWALLOWED status, then return game:Conf.JUDGE.LOSE. Otherwise, return arg. }.
Hook (helper5 tied to this state) into enemyContainer's 'aiHook' as the JUDGE_VICTORY hook named "judgeVictory".

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
If arg is at least the numeric entry "turns_to_swallow_strong" in aiArg, then return "regurgitate_strong".
Otherwise, if arg is more than the numeric entry "turns_to_swallow_weak" in aiArg, then return "regurgitate_middle".
Otherwise, return "regurgitate_weak".
